sources.title: Irrationality of values of $L$-functions for real Dirichlet characters
sources.role_in_paper: Related claimed irrational-value count, with an explicit qualification and a counterexample to the v1 Lemma 18. No theorem or construction from this source is an input to the present proof.
sources.actual_read_scope: The introduction and main announced statement were revisited. Earlier detailed reading and exact tests of selected construction and denominator claims are recorded in literature/audits/kumar-tosi-v1-2026-11-02/. The full preprint remains unaudited. The zero-case contradiction is stated in full in the footnote; it does not disprove the main theorem.
